title: The electron as the trefoil knot on $\Sigma_4$
html:
Example. The electron as the trefoil knot on \Sigma_4

The electron represents the simplest nontrivial torus knot embedded on \Sigma_4: the trefoil T_{2,3}. Its Seifert genus is (2-1)(3-1)/2 = 1 \leq 4. With 3 crossings, the trefoil carries 3 units of information. Its Jones polynomial is:

  J_{T_{2,3}}(q) = -q^{-4} + q^{-3} + q^{-1}

This example records the trefoil geometry only. The electron mass m_e is CAL-1, the leptonic mass-scale input used to normalize the observable tower; it is not derived here from a standalone trefoil formula.
